import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Finprod
import Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Basic

/-!
# Pointwise finite sums of integral cochains

A sequence of integral cochains that is eventually zero on each chain has a
well-defined pointwise sum. Its value is any finite partial sum containing
all the nonzero terms at that chain.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {C : ModuleCat ℤ} (f : ℕ → (C ⟶ ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ))
  (hf : ∀ c : C, ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ K, f k c = 0)

private theorem eventuallyZeroCochain_finiteSupport (f : ℕ → (C ⟶ ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ))
    (hf : ∀ c : C, ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ K, f k c = 0) (c : C) :
    Function.HasFiniteSupport (fun k => f k c) := by
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := hf c
  refine (Finset.range K).finite_toSet.subset ?_
  intro k hk
  simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_range]
  exact Nat.lt_of_not_ge (fun hkK => hk (hK k hkK))

/-- Sum a sequence of integral cochains that is eventually zero at every chain. -/
def eventualCochainSum (f : ℕ → (C ⟶ ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ))
    (hf : ∀ c : C, ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ K, f k c = 0) : C ⟶ ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ :=
  ModuleCat.ofHom
    { toFun := fun c => ∑ᶠ k, f k c
      map_add' := fun c d => by
        simpa only [map_add] using finsum_add_distrib
          (eventuallyZeroCochain_finiteSupport f hf c)
          (eventuallyZeroCochain_finiteSupport f hf d)
      map_smul' := fun r c => by
        simpa only [map_smul, RingHom.id_apply] using
          (smul_finsum' r (eventuallyZeroCochain_finiteSupport f hf c)).symm }

/-- At a chain, the pointwise sum is the corresponding finite-support sum. -/
@[simp]
theorem eventualCochainSum_apply (c : C) :
    eventualCochainSum f hf c = ∑ᶠ k, f k c := rfl

/-- Any bound for eventual vanishing computes the sum by a finite partial sum. -/
theorem eventualCochainSum_apply_eq_sum (c : C) (K : ℕ)
    (hK : ∀ k ≥ K, f k c = 0) :
    eventualCochainSum f hf c = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, f k c := by
  apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
  intro k hk
  simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_range]
  exact Nat.lt_of_not_ge (fun hkK => hk (hK k hkK))

end Mumford.Analytic
